title: Bind actual BIT paid owners to the existing lockstep role audit
body:
## Summary

Bind the actual PR4440 BIT paid-owner chronology to Mark/Matarener's existing live-role audit, taking its explicit remaining BIT handoff. Preserve its completed I1–I6 proof and code; add no allocator or stock calculation.

```text
actual BIT controller + PR589 records
  57,555 paid owners and 18 COPY lifetime templates
  symbolic whole-job v=2 binding
  existing live-role stack primitive
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** the live-role audit used random BIT-shaped owner orders and explicitly requested the actual raw BIT list. **After:** a source-bound compressed list preserves all 57,555 paid positions and the exact histogram; the 11,454 productive field ranks match the unchanged invoice.
- Both local directions check source immutability, last COPY-buffer read and cleanup. A two-role witness at actual paid position 1,601 reuses the predecessor stack primitive; alias, unscaled partial-job, premature-parent-clear and actual early-buffer-clear controls reject.
- The `v=2` counts are 131,194,116 productive arrays and 3,312,578,025 paid positions, represented symbolically. Registered normal and `-O` replay pass in 0.42 seconds. No Cartesian word or physical tape allocator is emitted; all native/whole-job/owned-erasure hypotheses remain.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

New research package only; frozen predecessors and selected frontier stay unchanged. Prepared for JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, retaining Mark/Matarener, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, Cinna Davis and PR589/native lineage credit.
